citations.narrative:
- There is currently no public barrier separating the public from the buffalo enclosure fence, and there are no facility
employees overseeing any potential public interactions with the animals. With the current setup, it is possible that
members of the public could make contact with the animals if they were standing next to the enclosure fence. This poses
a potential risk to both the animals and the members of the public. The facility must ensure that all animals are handled
with minimal risk of harm to the animals and to the public. The facility must provide a barrier to prevent members of the
public from making unauthorized contact with the animals.
Correct by 10 August 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with licensee.
